scopeLabel: Motorola Mobility Japan official fan-club product lineup: 12 explicitly listed smartphones (razr, edge, moto g), excluding the single moto pen accessory

universe.populationMethod: live official Motorola Japan product lineup H4 manufacturer-owned image alt text; 13 product H4 titles minus 1 explicitly accessory pen = 12 marketed smartphone identities
universe.notes: These 12 are one bounded manufacturer Japan currently listed phone lineup, not all historically sold Motorola devices. The corresponding support user guides may use standard no-space spelling (moto g37j, moto g06, moto g66j 5G) while the manufacturer lineup image alt uses spaced stylization; manufacturer official exact device title, explicit alternate manufacturer article and independently corroborated identity are required before accepting each. A general help.php?m=... URL is candidate discovery only. Live Motorola JP source 2026-10-31: 13 official H4 products, 12 smartphones + 1 accessory. Reviews of all 12 published manufacturer-controlled exact model user guides found 11 direct (10 exact English, 1 exact Japanese) and one held Japanese moto g37j: generic worldwide guide title is moto g37 (not exact) and the manufacturer Japan specific exact HTML user guide returned HTTP 403 in GitHub Actions. The JP documentation existing elsewhere does not justify claiming that the independently unverified deep guide is direct. Full 12 population preserved.

liveReview.notes: All direct links resolve to manufacturer-operated HTTPS model exact HTML operating manual indexes with substantial content. No generated URL accepted without final page verification. Held remains in locked universe, not public runtime.
